name: RegistrationEntry
description: SPIRE Server registration entry defining the SPIFFE ID issued to workloads matching a set of selectors.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier assigned by the SPIRE Server.

fields.name: spiffe_id
fields.description: The SPIFFE ID issued to matching workloads (spiffe://{trust-domain}/{path}).

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: SPIFFE ID of the node or parent workload authorized to attest this entry.

fields.name: selectors
fields.description: List of type:value selector pairs that must all match for this entry to apply.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Attestation plugin type (e.g., k8s, unix, docker, aws_iid).

fields.name: ttl
fields.description: Time-to-live in seconds for SVIDs issued from this entry. 0 uses server default.

fields.name: federates_with
fields.description: Trust domain names this entry federates with.

fields.name: dns_names
fields.description: DNS Subject Alternative Names to include in X.509-SVIDs.

fields.name: admin
fields.description: Grants administrative access to the SPIRE Server API when true.

fields.name: downstream
fields.description: Marks this entry as a downstream SPIRE Server in a nested topology.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp after which this entry expires. 0 means no expiry.

fields.name: hint
fields.description: Optional hint for workloads holding multiple SVIDs.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp when this entry was created.
